scopeNotes: Five slices built by a multi-agent package: read-only investigation, ranked scopes, per-slice implementer, three adversarial reviewers, fix round and release-gate verifier in isolated worktrees; merged and re-gated here.

Hazards are the only simulation change; they are pure functions of the integer tick and frozen anchors with no RNG. No HMH replay fixtures exist; encounter outcomes near the four hazard anchors differ from the preceding build by design.
Explosive zones, destructibles, the shake-intensity setting and the audio weight pass were deferred (see the reconciliation handoff).
Desktop and phone-size browser checks are scoped release checks, not physical-device or full AAA certification.
SETTLEMENT_LIVE remains false; Ranked entry pricing, platform fee and Mainnet items remain owner-gated.
